physics_and_start: Byte-identical immutable mesh, physical dictionaries, actuator/controller source and exact0.6 U,p; identical controller reinitialization. Same time-step controls and0.6–0.62 s end window. No phi seed.
reference_selection: Run fresh native CPU serial/direct-GAMG and native CPU MPI2/direct-GAMG under the same host load; use the faster full-run elapsed time as the native denominator. Report both CPU results, and also compare steady rates against the better native steady rate.

accuracy.relative_L2_definition: sqrt(sum(V*|candidate-reference|^2)/sum(V*|reference|^2)); vector norm for U; same anchored pressure gauge with no fitted offset. Zero/near-zero denominator is inconclusive rather than an automatic pass.
accuracy.mean_definition: Time-weighted means from actual computed force/power diagnostics over0.61–0.62 s, with identical endpoint handling for all variants.
accuracy.native_consistency_required: Check CPU1 versus CPU2 physical/field consistency too; do not use a numerically suspect comparator merely because it is faster.
accuracy.continuity: No unexplained deterioration versus fresh native CPU envelope. Flag any peak absolute local/global/cumulative continuity metric above the larger native value plus1e-12 for explicit review; no automatic default eligibility while flagged.

gpu_execution_evidence: Actual Ginkgo CudaExecutor description, CUDA device id and owner rank recorded after executor creation in real CFD logs
Successful real CUDA-buffer and CUDA reduction MPI gate before CFD
One-second GPU/process/utilization samples plus loaded GPU-library maps and host foamRun states; WSL nvidia-smi limitations explicitly retained

timing.report_startup: Solver launch to first completed physical time step, observed from the first native ExecutionTime record; includes first matrix/device setup. Record observation polling uncertainty.
timing.report_steady: After first completed step to last completed step: wall time, physical time advanced, step count and steady simulated-seconds/wall-second rate; report native log CPU/ClockTime counters too.
timing.report_full: Full runner wall including input verification, decomposition, solver/device startup/transfers, reconstruction and cleanup; solver phase also separately reported.
timing.default_policy: This20% wall reduction is a practical screening threshold, not automatic adoption. A tiny/ambiguous gain, host-load mismatch, missing accuracy evidence or worse steady throughput leaves CUDA nondefault; root retains the production decision. Longer-run/batch throughput confirmation may still be needed.
